plain:
歌名：喜乐河流
专辑：从早晨到夜晚
音乐人：赞美之泉

喜乐河流
River of Joy

词、曲：游智伟 David Yu
中文译词：郑懋柔

喜乐河流 来充满我
I want to go to the river of joy
生命泉源 来浇灌我
I want to go to the river of life
有袮同行 不再惧怕
I'm not afraid.He is with me
无论何处 紧紧跟随
I want to be where He leads me

我要walk walk
I will walk,walk
Walk in the river
Walk in the river
我要jump jump
I will jump,jump
Jump in the river
Jump in the river
我要dance dance
I will dance,dance
Dance in the river of joy
Dance in the river of joy

点击听歌☞ https://zanms.net/s34491
